content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 9's cap is mutual and mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, and Section 8 (Indemnification) liability is already carved out of both — so indemnities sit outside the cap. But the clause fails the fallback because (1) the cap is confined to amounts paid "for the transaction which the liability relates to", which is not a genuine twelve-month fee cap, and (2) nothing anywhere carves out confidentiality breaches (Section 10), gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

**Redline (fallback, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace in p0090 deleting the per-transaction limiter and adding the three missing carve-outs to the existing exception opener, leaving every other word verbatim. Preferred-only items (USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection/security, fraud, IP infringement, payment-obligation exclusion) are noted as open negotiating asks rather than drafted in.
